main_text.p: tere, quærere, inquirere, requirere: Petere panem, Mendicare: [Syriac] Quæsivit, interrogavit de pace, salute, Salutavit, Mar.9.14. ad Rom.16.3. Ch. id dicitur [Hebrew], ut 1.Sam.10.4. Pahel [Hebrew] Idem: & ex alia forma [Hebrew] Et petant, Psalm.109.10. Ithpah. [Hebrew] Ch. Quæri, inquiri, interrogari, invent. Syr. [Syriac] Ut cum inquisita fuerit causa ejus, Act.25.26. Ethpeh. [Syriac] Syr. Subterfugere, subducere se, excusare se, detrectare, aversari. Aphel [Hebrew] Mutuavit, Comodato dedit petenti, Exo.12.36. Lucæ 11.5.
[Hebrew] Chald. Postulatum, petitio. Syr. [Syriac] Petitionem ipsorum, Lucæ 23.24. Plur. cum Aff. [Hebrew] Omnes petitiones tuas, Psal. 20.6. [Syriac] Petitiones vestræ, ad Philip. 4.6.
[Hebrew] Ch. Idem. Cum Aff. [Hebrew] Petitione ipsorum, Psalm.106.15.
[Hebrew] Ch. Idem. Plur. const. [Hebrew] Petitiones cordis tui, Psal.37.4. Hebr. [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Ch. [Syriac] Syr. Infernus, Sepulchrum, sic dictum à petendo, quòd semper plures petat.
[Hebrew] Ch. Anhelare, aspirare. Partic. [Hebrew] Anhelat ad umbram, Jobi 7.2.
